Help me pick a laptop under 80,000 rupees for programming
8:36 PM

For programming under ₹80,000 go for 16GB memory, a 512GB SSD and a recent Ryzen 7, Core i5 or Core i7 chip. That matters more than a fancy graphics card.

Memory: 16GB is the minimum. 8GB gets slow with a browser, an editor and Docker open together.
Storage: 512GB SSD or more, ideally with a free slot to add more later.
Chip: A recent Ryzen 7, Core i5 or Core i7 is plenty. A MacBook Air with an M-series chip can also fit this budget on sale, and its battery lasts the longest.
Screen and keyboard: A bright 1080p screen and a comfortable keyboard. You'll look at both all day.
Graphics card: Only needed for games or machine learning work. Skip it otherwise and put the money into memory and build quality.

I haven't looked up today's prices, so check current shop listings before you buy. What will you mostly code: web apps, mobile apps, or machine learning?
